steps.en: The owner's latest mobile number is obtained from the data source
steps.id: Nomor mobile terbaru owner diambil dari sumber data
steps.why_en: The latest-number lookup is switched off by a setting, so the stored number is used.
steps.why_id: Pencarian nomor terbaru dimatikan oleh setelan, jadi nomor yang tersimpan dipakai.

steps.en: Each unique individual owner gets one combined message for their notices
steps.id: Setiap owner individu unik menerima satu pesan gabungan untuk notice-nya
steps.why_en: One owner can still receive several messages when their notices have different due dates.
steps.why_id: Satu owner tetap bisa menerima beberapa pesan bila notice-nya beda tanggal jatuh tempo.

steps.en: Opted-out, passport and no-number owners are not messaged
steps.id: Owner opt-out, passport, dan tanpa nomor tidak dikirimi pesan

steps.en: The message lists the unpaid notices and mentions the first letter
steps.id: Pesan memuat daftar notice belum dibayar dan menyebut surat pertama
steps.why_en: The message wording is stored in the database and cannot be confirmed from the code.
steps.why_id: Isi pesan disimpan di database dan tidak bisa dipastikan dari code.

steps.en: The message is sent to the owner's mobile phone
steps.why_en: Text messages are switched off in the production settings and the scheduled run is off too.
steps.why_id: SMS dimatikan di setelan produksi dan proses terjadwalnya juga mati.
